description: Permanently bulk-delete all memories whose context array contains an exact [key, value] pair (destructive, idempotent; consumes 1 Write API call) and return { deleted_count }. Scopes deletion to namespace (defaulting to MEMORIA_NAMESPACE when omitted locally) and rejects reserved "org:" prefixes. Use to purge memories tied to a deleted file, PR, or feature tag; use forget_memory instead when deleting a single memory by UUID.

key.description: Exact context tuple key to match (for example "file" or "pr").

namespace.description: Optional logical namespace scope (never prefix with "org:").

value.description: Exact context tuple value to match (for example "src/legacy.js").

name: delete_by_context

deleted_count.description: Number of matching memories deleted (0 if none matched).

title: Delete Memories by Context
